OVERVIEW

NFL decision-support dashboard

An evidence-first workspace for researching NFL lines and signals. All data is collected directly from official league sources, timestamped on retrieval, and every published row links back to the document it came from.

Executive summary

This project builds and publishes an NFL decision-support workspace from official league data only. It is organised around four linked workstreams: a requirements and questions inventory, a strategy catalogue with pre-registered validation gates, a correlation engine that measures dependence before pricing it, and an injury and depth tracker that maps unavailable starters to the replacement who must take the slot.

Availability. The current official injury report covers 28 clubs and 345 player entries. Cross-referencing it against the official game books yields 0 starter absences where the replacement could be identified from the league's own lineup and substitution records.

What is deliberately not claimed. No strategy is reported as having an edge. Closing-line value cannot be tested without a licensed, timestamped price history, and the league does not publish one, so the strategies are specified and gated but unranked. The leaderboard shows exactly that state rather than a placeholder number.

How to read this site

Every published row carries its own official-source link. Click the link in the final column of any table to open the league document the value came from. Values that could not be read from an official source are shown blank and are listed on the Flagged for review page. Nothing on this site is inferred, estimated or carried over from a secondary source.
RequirementsEvery requirement with its status and the evidence that satisfies it.Questions & gapsWhat is known, what is answered, what is still missing and the action that closes it.StrategiesThirteen strategies across single bets, parlays and player-prop combinations, with the leaderboard.Validation gatesThe ten pre-registered criteria every strategy must clear to be ranked.CorrelationsMeasured dependence with sample sizes and confidence intervals, and what remains unmeasured.Injuries & depthInjury designations joined to the replacement who takes the slot.SuggestionsProposals for review and selection before any of them are implemented.Flagged for reviewEverything that could not be verified from an official source.
